entryPointReview: C explode.c scatter (721-947) invokes stop_occupation only after thitu reports a successful hit. The real JS blow_up_landmine -> scatter -> thitu route is reached by runSimpleMonsterAction on planningState(game) with a tame pony, landmine, ordinary rock, unfinished meal and canned command. The regression proves the fix captures the selected action state; no gameplay, recorder, public runtime parity, or source certification is claimed.

functions.name: scatter
functions.sourceReview: Read the complete C explode.c scatter (721-947) and allmain.c stop_occupation. C successful-hit branch calls stop_occupation() on its current state. JS scatter remains unchanged and forwards (state, env); the narrow correction changes only runSimpleMonsterAction’s callback provider to close over its selected `state` and ignore call argument shape. Actual planned damage and state effects traverse real dog movement, postmov, mintrap, landmine, scatter and thitu.

callers.source: Existing normal preflight planningState→runSimpleMonsterAction→dochugw→tame pet dog_move→postmov→mintrap→landmine→scatter. C explode.c successful thitu calls stop_occupation on its current game; JS provider must target selected planning/live action state.
